mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline >0.3% in 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >60% of cases during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 thousand units signal weak consumer demand, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as market participants anticipate fiscal stimulus in response to housing sector weakness.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1600.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns negative in >50% of cases during housing downturns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1600 thousand and industrial production below 100 index level indicates supply chain disruption, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as markets price in sectoral recovery.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1600.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 5.0% during post-pandemic recovery phases indicates strong labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 during post-pandemic recovery but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent price pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as central bank tightening expectations increase equity risk premiums.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >50% of cases during high-inflation periods.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 0.5% quarterly signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate profit growth aligns with macroeconomic momentum.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >0.5% quarterly but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >55% of cases during expansion phases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 index level indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as market participants anticipate earnings deterioration in cyclical sectors.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns positive in >50% of cases during manufacturing contractions.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth above 0.5% and unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates labor market tightness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as wage growth supports consumer spending momentum.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 0.5 AND UNRATE < 5.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >45% of cases during tight labor market periods.
